projection: Inverse Web Mercator to lon/lat; project local campus XY approximation (X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040); then add HOVD_Root.matrix_parent_inverse XY translation to enter source-library frame. Approximate meters.
model_footprint_proxy: HOVD_Roof_Slab convex hull projected to XY; roof-slab perimeter is a source-model structural proxy, not an as-built survey.
interpretation: Overlay compares filled official GIS FID 618 footprint with the current source HOVD_Roof_Slab XY convex-hull proxy. The six structural wall meshes are separately bounded; portico, stairs, landscaping, height and master placement are not part of this source-library overlay. The project conversion is approximate, not a surveyed CRS; the parent agent separately checked the master placement marker against the manifest.
